events.title: Samuel Colt Patents the Revolver
events.description: Samuel Colt received a U.S. patent for his revolving-cylinder firearm, the Colt Paterson revolver, which featured a mechanism that rotated the cylinder to align each chamber with the barrel.
events.significance: The revolver transformed personal firearms and weapons manufacturing, and Colt's later use of interchangeable parts helped advance mass-production methods in American industry.

events.title: Sixteenth Amendment Ratified
events.description: The Sixteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was declared ratified after Delaware, Wyoming, and New Mexico approved it, giving Congress the power to levy an income tax without apportioning it among the states.
events.significance: The amendment created the constitutional basis for the federal income tax, which became the primary source of revenue for the U.S. government and enabled the expansion of federal programs in the 20th century.

events.title: Communist Coup in Czechoslovakia Concludes
events.description: President Edvard Beneš accepted the resignations of non-communist ministers and appointed a government dominated by Communists under Klement Gottwald, completing the February coup.
events.significance: The coup brought Czechoslovakia firmly into the Soviet sphere of influence for four decades and heightened Cold War tensions in Europe, influencing Western moves toward the formation of NATO.

events.title: People Power Revolution Ousts Ferdinand Marcos
events.description: After days of mass demonstrations and military defections following a disputed election, Ferdinand Marcos fled the Philippines and Corazon Aquino was sworn in as president.
events.significance: The largely nonviolent uprising ended two decades of authoritarian rule and became a model for peaceful democratic movements around the world.

events.title: Muhammad Ali Wins World Heavyweight Title
events.description: Cassius Clay, later known as Muhammad Ali, defeated Sonny Liston in Miami Beach when Liston failed to answer the bell for the seventh round, making Clay the heavyweight champion of the world.
events.significance: The upset launched Ali's career as one of the most influential athletes and cultural figures of the 20th century, and he announced his conversion to Islam and new name shortly afterward.
